title: Manganese Chemical-History Test: GALAH-first public-data screen with APOGEE replication
revision_reason: The downloaded public GALAH DR4 BSTEP FITS file contains age_bstep and e_age_bstep but does not contain the e16_age_bstep/e84_age_bstep fields described by the web documentation and assumed by v0.1. The first execution stopped at schema validation before any manganese-kinematic outcome was calculated. v0.2 replaces the nonexistent percentile fields with the published symmetric 1-sigma uncertainty e_age_bstep. No outcome-driven threshold, sign, voxel, nuisance, statistic, or alpha change is made.
scientific_role: history-sensitive kinematic screen; not a direct acceleration measurement and not a replacement for the stationary SPARC H I source package

hypothesis.persistence_compatible: A manganese-based chemical-history coordinate may retain reproducible association with local kinematic residual structure after present-location, age, bulk chemistry, selection, and conventional dynamical controls.
hypothesis.null: After those controls, manganese supplies no reproducible incremental dynamical information beyond ordinary stellar-population and disk-dynamical structure.

primary_survey.name: GALAH DR4
quality_cuts: finite teff, logg, fe_h, mg_fe, mn_fe, e_mn_fe
finite R_Rzphi, z_Rzphi, phi_Rzphi, vR_Rzphi, vT_Rzphi, vz_Rzphi
primary_survey.explicit_caveat: Do not use GALAH DR4 flag_fe_h as a quality gate because the survey documentation identifies a bug in that flag.

coordinates.derive_cartesian_galactocentric: x = R_Rzphi * cos(phi_Rzphi); y = R_Rzphi * sin(phi_Rzphi); z = z_Rzphi
coordinates.underpowered_rule: If the frozen cuts fail the power gate, report v0.2 as underpowered. Do not relax cuts or voxel sizes after any manganese-kinematic outcome is inspected; a revised design requires a new protocol version frozen first.

history_coordinate.construction: Fit an OLS nuisance model for mn_fe using standardized nuisance variables plus quadratic terms for fe_h and age_bstep and fixed effects for current-location voxel. Define Mn_history as the residual.
history_coordinate.age_sensitivity: Repeat as a declared sensitivity using the main-catalogue age instead of age_bstep if finite; do not choose between age estimators by outcome strength.

primary_kinematic_test.response_model: For each velocity component separately, fit OLS with current-location voxel fixed effects and the same standardized nuisance variables used for Mn_history; define the residual velocity after excluding manganese.
primary_kinematic_test.component_statistic: slope of residual_velocity on Mn_history, with HC1 heteroskedasticity-robust standard error
primary_kinematic_test.omnibus_statistic: T_Mn_3D = sum_k (beta_k / SE_k)^2 over vR, vT, vz

null_generation.method: permute Mn_history within current-location voxel and within coarse population strata before recomputing all component slopes

primary_kinematic_test.component_reporting: Always report beta_R, beta_T, beta_z and their signed effects; an omnibus p-value alone is insufficient.

dr20_linked_secondary.purpose: Test whether manganese stratifies the adjacent young-vs-old result rather than merely reproducing an age effect.
dr20_linked_secondary.estimand: age_cohort x Mn_history interaction in each velocity component under the same present-state controls
dr20_linked_secondary.interpretation: Secondary only and cannot rescue a null primary test.

mandatory_conventional_challenge.asymmetric_drift_and_disk_heating: A signal carried only by vT is not persistence evidence. Quantify velocity dispersions and a conventional asymmetric-drift expectation; repeat the manganese association on the drift-corrected azimuthal residual.
population_structure: repeat in narrow fe_h and mg_fe strata
test thin/thick-disk sensitivity without selecting the favorable subset
inspect age uncertainty and age-estimator consistency
mandatory_conventional_challenge.migration: Use orbital quantities only as a post-primary conventional challenge, not as primary nuisance variables, because actions/eccentricity are themselves derived from phase-space information.
mandatory_conventional_challenge.survival_condition: A positive result must not be solely azimuthal/asymmetric-drift driven and must survive the predeclared population/selection challenges without threshold tuning.

independent_replication.rule: Map APOGEE columns to the same scientific estimand; do not tune GALAH thresholds or signs to improve replication.
independent_replication.success: Same sign for every primary component with |standardized GALAH effect| >= 2 and replication omnibus permutation p <= 0.01 after the APOGEE conventional-dynamics challenge.
independent_replication.failure: Classify the GALAH result as survey-specific/unreplicated; do not promote the persistence interpretation.

manga_secondary_arm.guardrail: No MaNGA feature is called [Mn III] solely because excess flux is present at one predicted wavelength.

execution_lock: No manganese-dynamical outcome may be calculated before this v0.2 protocol is committed. Scientifically material changes require a new version committed before inspecting the affected outcome.
